classification: Intentional lean-source pruning 2026-10-31 from 401 to 120 physical test files: 281 source suites removed with their cases and expectations, not merged, archived or replaced. Selection retains all registered capability and knowledge proof paths, normal acceptance and native test entrypoints, plus 20 direct critical safety/acceptance/runtime/regression suites. This is a deliberate reduction in test coverage, NOT a claim of semantic equivalence or unchanged defect detection; 26 safety, 45 runtime, 36 regression, 12 acceptance and 162 development suites were removed. CI remains suspended. Exact GitHub source inventory checked; TypeScript, Vitest, map/Minecraft execution NOT EXECUTED.

reviewPolicy: source-reviewed reflects historical file review; case-inventory-reviewed means identifiable source cases and assertion sites, NOT full assertion/consumer equivalence, an executed test, or deletion approval
triagePolicy: Every registered test has owner and actionable triage; pinned-source-case-inventory records the exact source blob examined, not execution proof; risk hints remain provisional.

functionalAreaTaxonomy.rule: One primary functional area per test and optional non-exclusive mechanics tags. Path-based routing is provisional; case-inspected labels are not proof of runtime functionality.

arena.admission-authority.label: Arena joining, membership and authority evidence

audit.reliability.label: Regression knowledge, retest and release assurance

audit.task-context.label: Audit model tasks and context retrieval

entity.behavior.label: Entity AI stack, behavior and mounts

gameplay.semantic-model.label: Game architecture, behavioral and world semantic models

repair.release.label: Repair package staging and release gate

report.ui.label: Bug report UI and GitHub handoff

runtime.evidence.label: Runtime evidence authority, state, adapters, and validation

script.api-compatibility.label: Script API signatures and compatibility diagnostics

script.control-flow.label: Script control flow and call evidence

featureMappingPolicy: Feature and mechanic tags are navigation, not runtime or end-to-end proof. A source-case-inspected label means case names/important assertions were read on a pinned source commit, not complete semantic equivalence. Path-provisional rows are not certified by source review. Source-preserving family consolidation retains distinct describe/it bodies and records original paths with blob SHAs; never treat fewer files as fewer test cases.
